title: iOS build lane: cargo xtask ios writes CrewCraft.app for the iOS Simulator, with no Xcode project
spec: On macOS only, `cargo xtask ios --version <v> --out <dir> [--target sim-x86_64|sim-arm64]` builds apps/crewcraft in release mode for the iOS Simulator (x86_64-apple-ios or aarch64-apple-ios-sim; the default is the Mac's own architecture) with IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=17.0, checks the program is a 64-bit Mach-O for that CPU whose LC_BUILD_VERSION names the simulator platform (7) and iOS 17.0, and writes <dir>/CrewCraft.app, replacing an earlier one, signed ad hoc with `codesign --sign -` and verified. The bundle is flat and written in Rust, with no Xcode project, asset catalog, Swift or Objective-C: the program `crewcraft` (0755), `Info.plist`, `PkgInfo` (APPL????), the home-screen icons AppIcon60x60 at @2x (120 px) and @3x (180 px), as PNG files named for their scale, rendered from assets/icon/crewcraft.svg, and the license files in licenses/. The Info.plist (XML) has CFBundleIdentifier io.github.setsuad.crewcraft, CFBundleExecutable crewcraft, CFBundleName and CFBundleDisplayName CrewCraft, CFBundlePackageType APPL, CFBundleInfoDictionaryVersion 6.0, CFBundleShortVersionString the release's three numbers (the App Store form), CFBundleVersion the macOS/MSI numbering (0.1.0-beta.1 is 0.1.201), MinimumOSVersion 17.0 (SPEC D5), CFBundleIcons with CFBundleIconFiles AppIcon60x60, CFBundleSupportedPlatforms iPhoneSimulator, LSRequiresIPhoneOS true, UIDeviceFamily [1], an empty UILaunchScreen dict, UIRequiresFullScreen true and portrait orientation. A device target (aarch64-apple-ios) is refused with a message naming the missing signing identity (task T424). Elsewhere the command fails before building. The arguments, plist, icons, bundle layout and the Mach-O check are pure functions tested on Linux.
